/* selectEmailHistory - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
X.SEQIDX, X.SUBJECT, X.QRY, X.REJECT_SLIST_IDX, X.BLOCK_GROUP_IDX, X.MAILFROM, X.MAILTO, X.REPLYTO, X.ERRORSTO, X.HTML, X.ENCODING, X.CHARSET, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(X.SDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SDATE, X.REQ_DATE_MM, X.TDATE, X.DURATION_SET, X.CLICK_SET, X.SITE_SET, X.ATC_SET, X.GUBUN, X.RNAME, X.MTYPE, X.U_IDX, X.G_IDX, X.MSGFLAG, X.MAILIDX, (SELECT D.CONTENT FROM ISRY_EMS.IM_DMAIL_INFO_9 D WHERE D.SEQIDX = X.SEQIDX) AS CONTENT, X.USER_ID, X.USER_NAME
FROM ( SELECT SEQIDX, SUBJECT, QRY, REJECT_SLIST_IDX, BLOCK_GROUP_IDX, MAILFROM, MAILTO, REPLYTO, ERRORSTO, HTML, ENCODING, CHARSET, SDATE, SUBSTR(SDATE, 1, 6) AS REQ_DATE_MM, TDATE, DURATION_SET, CLICK_SET, SITE_SET, ATC_SET, GUBUN, RNAME, MTYPE, U_IDX, G_IDX, MSGFLAG, MAILIDX, /* CONTENT, */ C.USER_ID,
CASE WHEN E.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN C##RG.DEC_B64(G.FLNM_ENCPT) WHEN F.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN H.INST_NM WHEN E.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN C##RG.DEC_B64(I.FLNM_ENCPT) ELSE '' END AS USER_NAME
FROM ISRY_EMS.IM_DMAIL_INFO_9 C
LEFT JOIN SAA200 E /* 사용자 */ ON E.USER_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SAB230 F /* 사용자기관 */ ON F.USER_ID = E.USER_ID AND F.MAIST_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN SCA100 G /* 종사자 */ ON G.ENFSN_NO = E.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 H /* 통합기관 */ ON H.INST_NO = F.INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA200 I /* 청소년보호자 */ ON I.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = E.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
WHERE
C.USER_ID IS NULL OR C.USER_ID = 'system' OR C.USER_ID = #{SESSION_USER_ID}
C.USER_ID = #{SESSION_USER_ID}
ORDER BY SDATE DESC
) X
AND X.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{USER_ID} || '%'
AND (X.USER_NAME = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{USER_NAME}) OR X.USER_NAME = '____' || #{USER_NAME})
AND X.MAILTO LIKE '%' || #{MAILTO} || '%'
AND X.MAILFROM LIKE '%' || #{MAILFROM} || '%'
AND X.REQ_DATE_MM = #{REQ_DATE_MM}
OFFSET #{OFFSET_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY
